questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。根据后文提到的“whose dedication inspired me to come up with this expedition”可知，作者完成的是一次前往南极的探险（expedition）。A表示假日，C表示访问，D表示郊游，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(holiday)：语境句：We went on a relaxing holiday to the beach. 固定搭配：on holiday, public holiday
B(expedition)：语境句：The scientists organized an expedition to the Amazon rainforest. 固定搭配：go on an expedition, scientific expedition
C(visit)：语境句：I plan to pay a visit to my former teacher. 固定搭配：pay a visit to, return a visit
D(outing)：语境句：Our school organized a spring outing for the students. 固定搭配：go on an outing, family outing

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。根据前文他们打破了世界速度纪录，故此处意为把之前的最好成绩“缩短”了5天。“cut... off”可表示削减、缩短时间，符合句意。
questions.supplement:
A(cut)：语境句：The new road cuts our journey time in half. 固定搭配：cut down, cut off
B(spent)：语境句：She spent a lot of time reading books. 固定搭配：spend time doing, spend money on
C(kept)：语境句：He kept the secret to himself for years. 固定搭配：keep doing, keep in mind
D(extended)：语境句：The deadline for the project has been extended. 固定搭配：extend the deadline, extend a warm welcome

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词搭配。“make a journey”为固定搭配，意为“进行一次旅行/行程”。其他动词均不符合该固定表达的习惯用法。
questions.supplement:
A(describe)：语境句：Words cannot describe how grateful I am. 固定搭配：describe sth to sb, beyond description
B(make)：语境句：They made a long journey across the desert. 固定搭配：make a journey, make a decision
C(create)：语境句：The artist created a beautiful painting. 固定搭配：create an opportunity, create an atmosphere
D(start)：语境句：We need to start our preparation early. 固定搭配：start to do, start with

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。宾语是a sled(雪橇)，在南极的雪地上前进通常是“拖、拉”雪橇，因此dragging最符合动作逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(providing)：语境句：The hotel is providing excellent service for guests. 固定搭配：provide sth for sb, provide sb with sth
B(driving)：语境句：He was driving a red sports car. 固定搭配：drive a car, drive sb crazy
C(pushing)：语境句：She was pushing a shopping cart in the supermarket. 固定搭配：push forward, push for
D(dragging)：语境句：The boy was dragging his heavy suitcase along the street. 固定搭配：drag one's feet, drag on

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。句意为每天在零下40度“勇敢面对”巨大的逆风。brave在此作动词，意为“勇敢面对（困难或危险）”，非常生动且契合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(explored)：语境句：The researchers explored the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：explore the possibility, explore outer space
B(observed)：语境句：The doctor observed the patient's behavior carefully. 固定搭配：observe the rule, observe sb doing sth
C(braved)：语境句：They braved the heavy rain to attend the meeting. 固定搭配：brave the storm, brave the elements
D(measured)：语境句：The tailor measured me for a new suit. 固定搭配：measure up to, take measures

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词短语辨析。句意为冰缝上的薄冰桥随时可能“崩塌”，把人和雪橇带入深渊。give way意为“崩塌，支撑不住断裂”，完全符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(melt away)：语境句：His anger melted away when she smiled. 固定搭配：melt into, melt down
B(give way)：语境句：The bridge gave way under the weight of the truck. 固定搭配：give way to, give in
C(turn down)：语境句：She turned down the job offer because of the low salary. 固定搭配：turn down the volume, turn out
D(hold back)：语境句：He tried to hold back his tears. 固定搭配：hold back the truth, hold on

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析。前文提到遇到一个非凡的人，他的奉献精神“启发/鼓舞”（inspired）了作者发起这次探险。forced强迫，chose选择，均不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(forced)：语境句：The bad weather forced them to stay indoors. 固定搭配：force sb to do, be forced to do
B(chose)：语境句：She chose to study medicine at university. 固定搭配：choose from, choice of
C(expected)：语境句：We expected him to arrive on time. 固定搭配：expect sb to do, as expected
D(inspired)：语境句：His speech inspired us to work harder. 固定搭配：inspire sb to do, draw inspiration from

questions.explanation: 本题考察形容词辨析。后文提到这是一个“two-way street”(双向交流的途径)，说明他们建立的这个网站是可以“互动的”（interactive）。
questions.supplement:
A(interactive)：语境句：The museum has interactive exhibits for children. 固定搭配：interactive whiteboard, interactive communication
B(unusual)：语境句：It is unusual for him to be late. 固定搭配：unusual weather, highly unusual
C(familiar)：语境句：Her face seemed familiar to me. 固定搭配：be familiar with, be familiar to
D(temporary)：语境句：He is looking for a temporary job. 固定搭配：temporary accommodation, temporary relief

questions.explanation: 本题考察非谓语动词/动名词辨析。结合紧跟在后面的句子“So we would be blogging to these students...”可知，此处通过“写博客”来将全球的年轻人带入到这场探险中。选项中blogging最符合逻辑呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(blogging)：语境句：She earns a living by blogging about travel. 固定搭配：fashion blogging, live blogging
B(dancing)：语境句：They spent the whole night dancing at the party. 固定搭配：go dancing, dancing club
C(skiing)：语境句：We are going skiing in the Alps this winter. 固定搭配：go skiing, water skiing
D(acting)：语境句：He won an award for his brilliant acting. 固定搭配：acting career, voice acting

questions.explanation: 本题考察介词短语辨析。前句提到“我们给学生写博客记录”，本句说明学生“反过来”问我们问题，体现双向互动过程中的轮换与反馈，因此填In turn（反过来）。
questions.supplement:
A(In time)：语境句：We arrived at the station just in time for the train. 固定搭配：in time, on time
B(In common)：语境句：The two cultures have a lot in common. 固定搭配：have sth in common, in common with
C(In turn)：语境句：Stress causes lack of sleep, which in turn makes stress worse. 固定搭配：take turns, in one's turn
D(In particular)：语境句：I loved the food, in particular the dessert. 固定搭配：anything in particular, in general

questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。结合前面的互动描写（写博客与提问），网站成功充当了一个双向“交流/沟通”（communication）的途径。
questions.supplement:
A(appearance)：语境句：Judging by his appearance, he must be very rich. 固定搭配：make an appearance, physical appearance
B(transportation)：语境句：Public transportation is very convenient in this city. 固定搭配：public transportation, means of transportation
C(performance)：语境句：The band gave an excellent performance last night. 固定搭配：academic performance, live performance
D(communication)：语境句：Good communication is essential in a team. 固定搭配：effective communication, communication skills

questions.explanation: 本题考察名词辨析。经过艰苦卓绝的历程抵达南极点，完成了这件常人看似不可能的事，此时他们互相看着对方，眼神中满是“难以置信”（disbelief）。
questions.supplement:
A(disbelief)：语境句：He stared at the winning lottery ticket in disbelief. 固定搭配：shake one's head in disbelief, beyond belief
B(sadness)：语境句：She could not hide the sadness in her eyes. 固定搭配：a feeling of sadness, deep sadness
C(confusion)：语境句：The new rules caused a lot of confusion. 固定搭配：in confusion, avoid confusion
D(tiredness)：语境句：He collapsed from extreme tiredness. 固定搭配：physical tiredness, mental tiredness

questions.explanation: 本题考察动词辨析及搭配。“set sb doing sth”意为“使某人开始做某事”。紧接的问题“我从这次旅程中收获了什么？”表明作者陷入了“反思/沉思”（reflecting）。
questions.supplement:
A(regretting)：语境句：I am regretting my decision to quit the job. 固定搭配：regret doing sth, regret to say
B(reflecting)：语境句：He spent time reflecting on his past mistakes. 固定搭配：reflect on, set sb reflecting
C(complaining)：语境句：She is always complaining about the weather. 固定搭配：complain about, complain to sb
D(laughing)：语境句：The joke had everyone laughing loudly. 固定搭配：burst out laughing, laugh at

questions.explanation: 本题考察副词辨析。六年前他每天抽一包烟，暗示他当时的生活方式非常不健康、缺乏运动，因此选项中inactively（不活跃地）最符合语境中的对比意义。
questions.supplement:
A(healthily)：语境句：Eating healthily is important for your body. 固定搭配：live healthily, eat healthily
B(wonderfully)：语境句：The party was wonderfully organized. 固定搭配：wonderfully well, do wonderfully
C(inactively)：语境句：Sitting inactively for long hours can harm your health. 固定搭配：live inactively, behave inactively
D(secretly)：语境句：They were secretly married last year. 固定搭配：secretly hope, act secretly

questions.explanation: 本题考察形容词辨析。“be capable of doing sth”为固定搭配，意为“有能力做某事”。对应前文的“将不可能变为可能”，说明我们只要下定决心，就“有能力”完成任何事。
questions.supplement:
A(relieved)：语境句：I was relieved to hear that you arrived safely. 固定搭配：feel relieved, be relieved to hear
B(ashamed)：语境句：He felt ashamed of his rude behavior. 固定搭配：be ashamed of, feel ashamed
C(capable)：语境句：She is a highly capable teacher. 固定搭配：be capable of doing, capable hands
D(unaware)：语境句：He was completely unaware of the danger. 固定搭配：be unaware of, remain unaware

vocab_pack.definition_en: to set a new world record by surpassing the previous one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中与had构成过去完成时，broken是break的过去分词，表示在过去的某个时间点之前已经完成的动作
vocab_pack.example_en: The athlete broke the world speed record in the 100-meter dash.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位运动员在100米短跑中打破了世界速度纪录。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had just broken the world speed record

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce or remove a certain amount of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中cut是过去式（与原形同形），off为介词，整个短语意为从原有时间中减去
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to cut off at least two hours of travel time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要至少减少两个小时的旅行时间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cut five days off the previous best time

vocab_pack.definition_en: to travel a particular distance or route
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中made是过去式（不规则动词），journey前有定语entire 650-mile
vocab_pack.example_en: She made a journey across the desert alone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她独自进行了一次穿越沙漠的旅程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I became the first person in history to make the entire 650-mile journey

vocab_pack.definition_en: by walking, not using any vehicle
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用介词短语on feet，通常标准表达是on foot，此处作者用了复数feet强调双脚，学习时建议掌握标准形式on foot
vocab_pack.example_en: We decided to go to the park on foot.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们决定步行去公园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: solely on feet, without skis

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pull something heavy along the ground with effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用动名词形式dragging，作Imagine的宾语补足语，表伴随动作
vocab_pack.example_en: He had to drag the suitcase up the stairs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他不得不把行李箱拖上楼梯。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Imagine dragging a sled with 170 pounds of gear

vocab_pack.definition_en: to face danger, difficulty, or bad weather without fear
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 勇敢面对（危险、困难、恶劣天气等）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中braved是过去式，后接宾语a massive headwind，表示忍受/勇敢面对
vocab_pack.example_en: The firefighters braved the flames to rescue the child.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 消防员勇敢地冲进火焰救出孩子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We braved a massive headwind at -40℃ every single day.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very strong wind blowing directly against the direction of travel
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中massive修饰headwind，整个短语作braved的宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: The cyclist struggled against a massive headwind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自行车手与巨大的逆风搏斗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We braved a massive headwind

vocab_pack.definition_en: each day, emphasizing that it happens without exception
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作时间状语，修饰braved，表示每天如此
vocab_pack.example_en: He practices the piano every single day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他每天都练钢琴。
vocab_pack.from_passage: at -40℃ every single day

vocab_pack.definition_en: a narrow opening or break in the surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用复数形式cracks，作主语，后接in the ice说明冰面裂缝
vocab_pack.example_en: There are several cracks in the wall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 墙上有几条裂缝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: some of the cracks in the ice

vocab_pack.definition_en: to break, collapse, or yield under pressure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中give way前有情态动词could，表示可能性，意为可能坍塌
vocab_pack.example_en: The old bridge might give way in the storm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座旧桥可能在暴风雨中坍塌。
vocab_pack.from_passage: could give way at a moment's notice

vocab_pack.definition_en: immediately; with very little warning
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 随时，立刻（无需提前通知）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰give way，表示随时可能发生
vocab_pack.example_en: The soldiers are ready to leave at a moment's notice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 士兵们随时准备出发。
vocab_pack.from_passage: could give way at a moment's notice

vocab_pack.definition_en: a deep, vast hole or chasm, often used figuratively for extreme danger or despair
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作介词into的宾语，与the连用，表示掉入深渊
vocab_pack.example_en: The hiker fell into an abyss.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那名徒步者掉进了深渊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: into the abyss

vocab_pack.definition_en: very unusual, remarkable, or special
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰man，作定语
vocab_pack.example_en: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她有着非凡的音乐天赋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an extraordinary man

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of being committed to a task or purpose; hard work and devotion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作主语，whose dedication指代这个男人的奉献精神
vocab_pack.example_en: His dedication to education inspired many students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对教育的奉献激励了许多学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: whose dedication inspired me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think of or produce an idea, plan, or solution
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用不定式形式to come up with，与inspired me构成目的状语
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to come up with a new marketing strategy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要想出一个新的营销策略。
vocab_pack.from_passage: inspired me to come up with this expedition

vocab_pack.definition_en: involving communication between a user and a computer or between people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰website，作前置定语
vocab_pack.example_en: The website offers an interactive learning experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该网站提供互动式学习体验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a(n) interactive website

vocab_pack.definition_en: to write or contribute to a blog
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用动名词blogging，作介词on的宾语，表示参与博客活动
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people blog about their daily lives.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 很多人写博客记录日常生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: on blogging the expedition with me

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow the progress or movements of someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用现在分词tracking，作定语从句中的谓语，表示学生们正在追踪我们
vocab_pack.example_en: The police used GPS to track the stolen car.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 警方用GPS追踪被盗车辆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: students that were tracking us

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a result of something; in sequence or response
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作状语，位于句首，表示作为回应/反过来，他们问问题
vocab_pack.example_en: We helped him, and in turn, he offered us his support.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们帮助了他，反过来他也给予了我们支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In turn, they would ask us questions.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a situation where both sides have to put effort in for it to succeed; mutual exchange
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 双向的（关系/沟通），需要双方共同努力
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语，与as搭配(as a two-way street)，比喻沟通是双向的
vocab_pack.example_en: Communication in a relationship is a two-way street.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在关系中，沟通是双向的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as a two-way street of communication

vocab_pack.definition_en: an expression on someone's face showing they cannot believe something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用了复数looks，表示每个人脸上的表情，of disbelief作后置定语
vocab_pack.example_en: He gave me a look of disbelief when I told him the news.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当我告诉他这个消息时，他露出难以置信的表情。
vocab_pack.from_passage: We looked at each other with looks of disbelief

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to start doing something, especially thinking
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人开始做某事（尤指思考）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中set是过去式，me是间接宾语，reflecting是动名词作宾语补足语，表示使我开始反思
vocab_pack.example_en: The documentary set me thinking about the environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部纪录片让我开始思考环境问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which set me reflecting, 'What do I take from this journey?'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gain or learn something from an experience
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中take from用于疑问句，原形，后接宾语this journey，意为从这次旅程中得到什么
vocab_pack.example_en: What did you take from your year abroad?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你在国外的一年中学到了什么？
vocab_pack.from_passage: What do I take from this journey?

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who smokes one pack of cigarettes per day
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作表语(I had been a pack-a-day smoker)，前有不定冠词a，smoker为名词，pack-a-day是复合形容词
vocab_pack.example_en: He used to be a pack-a-day smoker before he quit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他戒烟前是一天一包烟的烟民。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had been a pack-a-day smoker

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that is not active; without much movement or effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作状语修饰living，表示过着不活跃的生活
vocab_pack.example_en: He sat inactively on the sofa all day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他整天懒散地坐在沙发上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: living inactively

vocab_pack.definition_en: every part of one's being or conviction, used for emphasis
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 全身心地；信念的每一部分
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作介词within的宾语，表示在我的信念的每一个纤维中，强调深信不疑
vocab_pack.example_en: He believed in the cause with every fiber of his being.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他全身心地相信这项事业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: within every fiber of my belief

vocab_pack.definition_en: to achieve something that seems impossible
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中用原形，因为是从句中can make后的原形，the impossible是名词化形容词作宾语，possible是宾补
vocab_pack.example_en: With hard work, we can make the impossible possible.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过努力工作，我们可以使不可能变成可能。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we can make the impossible possible

vocab_pack.definition_en: to decide to achieve something and focus all your effort on it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中set是过去式（与原形同形），mind用了复数our minds，to是介词，后接省略的动名词，整句意为我们下定决心去做的事
vocab_pack.example_en: If you set your mind to learning English, you will succeed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你下定决心学英语，你会成功的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we are capable of doing anything we set our minds to

vocab_pack.definition_en: the best (fastest) time achieved before the current one
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作介词off的宾语，表示从之前的最好时间中削减
vocab_pack.example_en: He improved his previous best time by two seconds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他将自己之前的最好成绩提高了两秒。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cut five days off the previous best time

vocab_pack.definition_en: only; not involving anything else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中修饰介词短语on feet，强调完全是步行
vocab_pack.example_en: The decision was based solely on the evidence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个决定完全基于证据。
vocab_pack.from_passage: solely on feet

section_2_word_form.passage:
Chinese culture, with its rich history and remarkable [56], has appealed to people around the world for centuries. [57] is reflected in various aspects of life, from interpersonal relationships to the balance between humans and nature, one of the most distinctive features of Chinese culture is its emphasis on harmony.
Traditional Chinese philosophy, influenced by Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism, [58] great importance on moral values and ethical behavior. Confucianism, [59] by Confucius, emphasizes the importance of filial piety, respect for elders, and social harmony. Taoism, on the other hand, advocates [60] in harmony with nature and seeking simplicity and humility.
Chinese literature, dating back thousands of years, is another treasure of cultural heritage. From ancient classics to great novels, Chinese literature offers remarkable insights [61] human nature and society. Poetry, in particular, holds a special place in Chinese culture, serving as [62] means of expressing emotions and philosophical ideas.
In recent years, there has been a growing interest in Chinese culture worldwide. This is [63] due to China's rising global influence and the increasing popularity of Chinese films, music, and cuisine. However, it is also a proof of the [64] appeal and common values embodied in Chinese culture. As the world becomes more interconnected, the exchange of cultures will undoubtedly enrich our understanding of each other and promote global harmony. China, with its rich cultural heritage, [65] to build bridges and foster mutual understanding among nations.

questions.explanation: 空格前有形容词remarkable修饰，故需填名词。deep的名词形式为depth（深度，深厚）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(depth)：语境句：The ocean's depth is difficult to measure accurately. 固定搭配：in depth, the depth of sth。原词deep其它变形：deeply(adv.), deepen(v.)

questions.explanation: 本题考察非限制性定语从句的引导词。逗号隔开了从句和主句，As在此引导非限制性定语从句，意为“正如在生活各方面所反映的那样”。句首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(As)：语境句：As is known to all, regular exercise is good for health. 固定搭配：as is known to all, as is expected

questions.explanation: 主语Traditional Chinese philosophy是单数第三人称，且全段描述客观事实，使用一般现在时。place importance on为固定搭配，意为“重视”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(places)：语境句：Our school places great emphasis on students' mental health. 固定搭配：place importance on, place emphasis on。原词place其它变形：placement(n.), replace(v.)

questions.explanation: Confucianism（儒家思想）与found（创立）之间是逻辑上的动宾关系（被动），故使用过去分词founded作后置定语（等于which was founded）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(founded)：语境句：The organization, founded in 1990, has helped many people. 固定搭配：be founded on/upon, newly founded。原词found其它变形：foundation(n.), founder(n.)

questions.explanation: advocate (提倡) 后习惯接动名词作宾语，即 advocate doing sth，故填 living。
questions.supplement: 正确形(living)：语境句：The doctor advocates eating more vegetables to stay healthy. 固定搭配：advocate doing sth, make a living。原词live其它变形：alive(adj.), lively(adj.)

questions.explanation: provide / offer insights into sth 是固定搭配，意为“对……提供深刻的见解/洞察力”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(into)：语境句：This documentary offers deep insights into animal behavior. 固定搭配：insight into, look into

questions.explanation: means作“方式，手段”解时单复数同形。此处指“一种”表达方式，由于未特指且表泛指单数，故填不定冠词a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：Bicycles are a popular means of transport in this city. 固定搭配：a means of, by means of

questions.explanation: 此处修饰介词短语 due to，需要用副词。part 的副词形式为 partly，意为“部分地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(partly)：语境句：His success was partly due to his hard work. 固定搭配：partly because, be partly responsible for。原词part其它变形：partial(adj.), participate(v.)

questions.explanation: 空格处需填形容词修饰名词 appeal。根据语意（与 common values 并列的经久不衰的吸引力），填入 timeless（永恒的，不受时间影响的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(timeless)：语境句：The classic novel has a timeless appeal to readers of all ages. 固定搭配：timeless beauty, timeless appeal。原词time其它变形：timely(adj.), timing(n.)

questions.explanation: 主语是 China，结合句意“中国处于有利位置以建立桥梁”，应用动词的被动语态 be positioned (to do sth) 来表示状态。陈述现状使用一般现在时。
knowledge_points: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.supplement: 正确形(is positioned)：语境句：The company is well positioned to expand its market globally. 固定搭配：be positioned to do, in a position to do。原词position其它变形：positive(adj.)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract or interest someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在完成时（has appealed to），主语 Chinese culture（第三人称单数），表示从过去到现在持续吸引。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient philosophy appeals to modern people seeking inner peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古老的哲学吸引了寻求内心宁静的现代人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has appealed to people around the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be shown or demonstrated in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时被动语态（is reflected in），用于 as 引导的定语从句中，as 指代主句内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cultural diversity is reflected in the local festivals.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文化多样性体现在当地的节日中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As is reflected in various aspects of life

vocab_pack.definition_en: special importance or attention given to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作表语（its emphasis on harmony），表示对和谐的重视。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school puts a strong emphasis on creativity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校非常注重创造力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its emphasis on harmony

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider something as very significant
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时，主语 Confucianism（第三人称单数），谓语 places，后接宾语和介词 on。
vocab_pack.example_en: Parents should place great importance on their children's education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 父母应高度重视孩子的教育。
vocab_pack.from_passage: places great importance on moral values and ethical behavior

vocab_pack.definition_en: the virtue of respect and care for one's parents and elders
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语，与 respect for elders 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: In traditional Chinese culture, filial piety is considered a fundamental virtue.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在中国传统文化中，孝道被视为基本美德。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the importance of filial piety

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of showing honor and deference to older people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语，与 filial piety 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: Respect for elders is deeply rooted in many Asian cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尊敬长辈深深植根于许多亚洲文化中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: filial piety, respect for elders

vocab_pack.definition_en: a state of peaceful coexistence and cooperation in society
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（emphasizes ... social harmony）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Promoting social harmony is a key goal of the government.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 促进社会和谐是政府的一个关键目标。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and social harmony

vocab_pack.definition_en: to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时，主语 Taoism（第三人称单数），谓语 advocates，后接动名词短语作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many environmentalists advocate reducing carbon emissions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多环保人士主张减少碳排放。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Taoism, on the other hand, advocates living in harmony with nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a state of agreement or peaceful coexistence with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为介词短语，作状语，修饰 living，表示与自然和谐地生活。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should live in harmony with the environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应与环境和谐共处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: living in harmony with nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to find or obtain something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词（seeking），与 living 并列作宾语，表示同时寻求简朴和谦逊。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people seek happiness through material possessions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人通过物质财富寻求幸福。
vocab_pack.from_passage: seeking simplicity and humility

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have existed since a particular time in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词短语（dating back），作定语，修饰 Chinese literature，表示追溯到数千年以前。
vocab_pack.example_en: The tradition dates back to the Tang dynasty.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这一传统可追溯到唐朝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dating back thousands of years

vocab_pack.definition_en: the traditions, achievements, and values that are passed down from previous generations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（treasure of cultural heritage），表示文化遗产的宝藏。
vocab_pack.example_en: Protecting cultural heritage is crucial for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保护文化遗产对后代至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: another treasure of cultural heritage

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide a deep understanding of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时，主语 Chinese literature（第三人称单数），谓语 offers，后接名词短语和介词 into。
vocab_pack.example_en: This book offers insights into human behavior.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本书提供了对人类行为的深刻见解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: offers remarkable insights into human nature and society

vocab_pack.definition_en: to occupy a unique or important position
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 占据特殊地位；备受珍视
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为一般现在时，主语 Poetry（第三人称单数），谓语 holds，后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music holds a special place in her heart.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐在她心中占有特殊地位。
vocab_pack.from_passage: holds a special place in Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to function or be used as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为现在分词短语（serving as），作状语，表示诗歌作为表达情感和哲学思想的方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The room serves as both a study and a guest room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个房间兼作书房和客房。
vocab_pack.from_passage: serving as a means of expressing emotions

vocab_pack.definition_en: a method or way of doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（serving as a means of expressing），表示作为表达的一种方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Language is a means of communication.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 语言是一种交流手段。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a means of expressing emotions and philosophical ideas

vocab_pack.definition_en: an increasing curiosity or attention towards something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，用于 there be 句型（There has been a growing interest in），作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is a growing interest in renewable energy sources.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人们对可再生能源的兴趣日益增长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a growing interest in Chinese culture worldwide

vocab_pack.definition_en: partially because of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为固定短语，作表语（This is partly due to），表示原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: The delay was partly due to bad weather.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 延误部分是由于恶劣天气造成的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: partly due to China's rising global influence

vocab_pack.definition_en: an enduring attractiveness that does not fade over time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（proof of the timeless appeal），表示不朽的吸引力。
vocab_pack.example_en: Classic literature has a timeless appeal across generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经典文学具有跨越世代的永恒吸引力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the timeless appeal and common values

vocab_pack.definition_en: shared beliefs or principles among a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（common values embodied in Chinese culture），表示中国文化中蕴含的共同价值观。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two countries share common values such as peace and justice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 两国拥有和平、正义等共同价值观。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the timeless appeal and common values embodied in Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: represented or expressed in a tangible form
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词短语（embodied in），作后置定语，修饰 values，表示被包含在中国文化中的共同价值观。
vocab_pack.example_en: The principles are embodied in the organization's code of conduct.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些原则体现在该组织的行为准则中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: common values embodied in Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: mutually connected or related
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为形容词，作表语（becomes more interconnected），表示世界变得更加互联。
vocab_pack.example_en: In a globalized world, economies are deeply interconnected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在全球化的世界中，经济是深度互联的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the world becomes more interconnected

vocab_pack.definition_en: the mutual sharing and interaction between different cultures
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作主语（the exchange of cultures will ...），表示文化交流。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exchange of cultures promotes mutual understanding between nations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文化交流促进国家间的相互理解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the exchange of cultures will undoubtedly enrich our understanding

vocab_pack.definition_en: to improve or enhance the quality or value of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形，用于将来时（will ... enrich），表示文化交流将丰富我们的理解。
vocab_pack.example_en: Reading can enrich your knowledge and broaden your horizons.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 阅读能丰富你的知识，开阔你的视野。
vocab_pack.from_passage: enrich our understanding of each other

vocab_pack.definition_en: to encourage the growth, development, or popularity of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形，用于将来时（will ... promote），表示促进全球和谐。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government aims to promote renewable energy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府旨在推广可再生能源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promote global harmony

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in a suitable situation or condition to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时被动语态（is positioned to），表示中国被置于能够搭建桥梁的位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: With advanced technology, the company is positioned to lead the market.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 凭借先进的技术，这家公司有能力引领市场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is positioned to build bridges

vocab_pack.definition_en: to create connections or improve relations between different groups
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 搭建桥梁；建立联系，促进沟通
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式短语（to build bridges），作目的状语，表示为了搭建桥梁。
vocab_pack.example_en: Cultural exchanges help build bridges between different communities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文化交流有助于在不同社区之间搭建桥梁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to build bridges and foster mutual understanding

vocab_pack.definition_en: to encourage the development or growth of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为动词原形，用于不定式（to foster），与 build bridges 并列，表示促进相互理解。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teachers should foster a love of learning in students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教师应培养学生对学习的热爱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: foster mutual understanding among nations

vocab_pack.definition_en: a shared comprehension and appreciation between two or more parties
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作宾语（foster mutual understanding），表示促进相互理解。
vocab_pack.example_en: Dialogue is essential for building mutual understanding between cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对话对于建立文化间的相互理解至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: foster mutual understanding among nations

vocab_pack.definition_en: characteristic qualities that make something easily recognizable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，用于 one of the most distinctive features，作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: One distinctive feature of the building is its green roof.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座建筑的一个显著特征是它的绿色屋顶。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one of the most distinctive features of Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: relationships between people, especially in social or professional contexts
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语，作介词 from 的宾语（from interpersonal relationships），表示从人际关系方面。
vocab_pack.example_en: Good interpersonal relationships are key to a successful career.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 良好的人际关系是事业成功的关键。
vocab_pack.from_passage: from interpersonal relationships to the balance between humans and nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: a state of equilibrium or harmony between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为名词短语（the balance between humans and nature），作介词 to 的宾语，表示人与自然之间的平衡。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is important to maintain a balance between work and leisure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保持工作与休闲的平衡很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the balance between humans and nature
